recommendedTextbook.title: Countdown to WASSCE/SSCE English Language
recommendedTextbook.author: O. Ogunsanwo and C. E. Oyetunde
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Nouns and Noun Phrases in Syntactic Positions
subtopics: Types of nouns (proper, common, abstract, collective)
Functions of noun phrases: Subject, object, complement
objectives: Identify noun phrases and their heads in complex sentences
Analyze grammatical functions of noun phrases
Transform verbs and adjectives into formal nominal expressions

topics.topic: Tenses and Aspect in English: Present and Past Perfect
subtopics: Simple present and present continuous aspect
Past perfect vs past simple distinctions
Future continuous and future perfect usage in formal writing
objectives: Use regular and irregular past participles accurately
Apply past perfect tense to sequence earlier past actions
Proofread narrative passages for tense consistency

topics.topic: Reading Comprehension: Topic Sentences and Main Ideas
subtopics: Locating topic sentences in initial, medial, and final positions
Differentiating main ideas from supporting details
objectives: Isolate the thesis sentence of an argumentative passage
Summarize paragraph points in concise single sentences
Infer author's attitude and tone in WASSCE comprehension texts

topics.topic: Continuous Writing: Narrative and Descriptive Essays
subtopics: Features of narrative essays: Plot, characterization, dialogue
Techniques of descriptive essays: Sensory imagery and spatial organization
Paragraph transition words and cohesive devices
objectives: Outline a 450-word narrative essay adhering to WAEC rubric
Incorporate vivid auditory and visual sensory details
Use subordinating conjunctions to vary sentence structures
